content.text: Rate limiter behavior during Redis failover is only verified manually after incidents.
Add chaos tests that kill the primary Redis node mid-burst and assert fail-open versus fail-closed modes match configuration for each limiter class.
Record recovery time and duplicate allow decisions so we can set SLOs for the rate limiting control plane.
